title: Niagara Falls Power in Buffalo
version: Electrical Review vol. 29 no. 21, 18 November 1896, pp. 247–249; digitized trade report
lineage: Contemporary trade-journal report; the brief article describes first test and delivery, not permanent unbroken service. Its description of the generating phase differs from later histories, so phase is not asserted here.

passages.note: Headline and opening: contracted power delivered after midnight 16 November 1896 to Buffalo Railway Company; line and transformer description.
